cad.title: Mitre Gauge
cad.description: This mitre gauge was constructed as part of a project for my Level 3 Engineering BTEC. It was modelled by measuring each dimension, creating each part, and then putting it all together in an assembly to ensure compatibility.

cad.title: Vice
cad.description: Similar to the mitre gauge, this vice was also a project for my Engineering course. I measured the physical dimensions of the vice, then proceeded to model it in SolidWorks.
